title: Zesty Fresh Italian Tuna Vitello Tonnato
description: A fresh and nostalgic Italian dish featuring tuna, capers, and a zesty sauce, made diabetic-friendly with ground nut oil and leaf-wrap-steam cooking method.
instructions: Preheat the steamer to 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the tuna, capers, lemon juice, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
Lay a lettuce leaf flat on a work surface and place about 1/4 cup of the tuna mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining lettuce leaves and tuna mixture.
Place the rolls in the steamer, seam-side down, and steam for 10 minutes.
Remove the rolls from the steamer and let them cool to room temperature.
Drizzle the ground nut oil over the rolls and serve immediately.
